 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Souvenir"** refers to a thing that is kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event. (स्मारिका)
 
 
• **Example: **She bought a small model of the Eiffel Tower as a souvenir from her trip to Paris.
 
 
 
• The word **"Suseptible"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Susceptible"**, which means likely or liable to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing. (संवेदनशील)
 
 
• **Example: **Children are more susceptible to the effects of poor nutrition.
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrect spelling is **"Suseptible"**, making option 3 the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Symbolise **(प्रतीक): To represent something.
 
 
• **Example:** The dove symbolises peace in many cultures.
 
 
 
• **Sympathetic **(सहानुभूतिपूर्ण): Feeling, showing, or expressing sympathy.
 
 
• **Example: **She was sympathetic towards the plight of the homeless.
